# Synthetic fixtures

Generated by `tools/legacy-oracle/make-fixtures.mjs` (`make fixtures`). **Do not edit by hand**: change the script and regenerate.
Every value is invented. Account-like numbers use the all-zero form allowlisted by `tools/check-private.sh`.
Git treats these files as binary (`.gitattributes`), so encodings, BOMs and line endings are preserved byte for byte.

58 files.

## Edge cases

| File | Encoding | EOL | BOM | Intent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `01-utf8-bom.csv` | utf-8 | LF | yes | UTF-8 with BOM; the BOM must not leak into the first header name. |
| `02-utf8-no-bom.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | UTF-8 without BOM, Polish letters in every column type. |
| `03-windows-1250.csv` | windows-1250 | CRLF | no | Windows-1250 bytes with all 18 Polish letters; auto-detect must fall back from UTF-8 to Windows-1250. |
| `04-iso-8859-2.csv` | iso-8859-2 | LF | no | ISO-8859-2 bytes. Auto-detect decodes them as Windows-1250, so Ą/ą/Ś/ś/Ź/ź come out wrong; only the manual ISO-8859-2 option is correct. |
| `05-windows-1252.csv` | windows-1252 | CRLF | no | Windows-1252 (Western European): € sign and accented letters; manual option only. |
| `06-bank-preamble.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | 5 lines of account information before the header; auto header = first row with the modal field count. |
| `07-trailing-delimiters.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | Every line ends with ";;" — the resulting empty unnamed columns must be dropped. |

## Bank look-alikes

| File | Encoding | EOL | BOM | Intent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `banks/pekao-like.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | Pekao layout: UTF-8, LF, ";", dd.mm.yyyy, comma decimals, ' account/reference prefixes, payee padded with spaces before the city. |
| `banks/pko-bp-like.csv` | windows-1250 | CRLF | no | PKO BP layout: Windows-1250, CRLF, ",", ISO dates, dot decimals without fixed scale. The header has 6 named + 5 blank columns and extra description fields spill into the blank columns, so the legacy header rule picks a data row (MVP bug). Blank lines between groups; one quoted field contains a comma. |
| `banks/mbank-like.csv` | utf-8 | CRLF | yes | mBank layout: UTF-8 with BOM, CRLF, ";". A ~25-line preamble (bank address with leading tabs, client, period, account, per-currency summary). The header "#Data operacji;#Opis operacji;#Rachunek;#Kategoria;#Kwota;" has 6 fields but data rows end in ";;" and have 7, so the legacy rule never picks the header (MVP bug). Amounts carry a " PLN" suffix; descriptions are quoted and padded with long runs of spaces. |

## Overlap set

| File | Encoding | EOL | BOM | Intent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `overlap/A_jan-mar.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | Overlap set, export A: January–March. Contains two genuine identical coffees on 03.01 and two identical purchases on 21.03. |
| `overlap/B_mar-may.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | Overlap set, export B: March–May; March overlaps A (same rows, so they dedupe; the 21.03 pair is kept twice, not four times). |
| `overlap/C_q1_again.csv` | utf-8 | LF | no | Overlap set, export C: the same rows as A plus one genuine identical second purchase (a third 03.01 coffee), so exactly one extra row survives. |
